texts.preamble: Mr. Bhat Fayaz vs Mr. Shah Aamir on 18 March, 2019 Author: Ali Mohammad Magrey
texts.facts: Petitioners are also aggrieved of the action of the respondents in having them re-designated as Food Safety Officers in tune with the mandate of the application of the Food Safety Standard Act and Rules 2006. Petitioners have submitted that there are having hardly any chances of their promotions in view of the non- availability of section posts, therefore, seek creation of further posts. Creation of posts is within the domain the Government to be made in terms of the requirement. Petitioners cannot claim creation of the post as a matter of right for their further benefit. It is submitted that proposal for change in nomenclature is lying with the Government.
